description: Astro's @astrojs/cloudflare adapter auto-generates a _routes.json shaped exactly like this (include everything, exclude known static files) whenever the build has any prerender:false route — but its exclude-list computation doesn't know about files @astrojs/sitemap writes directly to dist/ after the adapter runs, so /sitemap-index.xml and /sitemap-0.xml were missing and fell through to src/pages/[...path].astro's catch-all, which rewrote them to a 404 (confirmed via the x-astro-rewrite response header). This file overrides the auto-generated one with the same list plus those two paths. Re-diff this against a fresh `npm run build`'s dist/_routes.json whenever new pages or sitemap files are added, since Astro won't know to update this copy for you.
